<!-- Release: v0.20.1 -->

Development APK for Android 8 or newer. Signed with the project development key; uses a separate `.debug` application ID. Production distribution signing is not configured.

## Changes

- Rounded, connected selection glass with visible depth, continuous joins and readable album labels; removes oversized circular artifacts.
- Menu squash/stretch responds to motion and stopping, with fewer redundant rendering passes and cached selection geometry.

## Resolved issues

- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/102 - Connected selection geometry, depth and animation.
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/103 - Menu deformation and rendering efficiency.

## Install

1. Download `localica-v0.20.1-debug.apk` from **Assets** below (Android 8+).
2. Open the APK and allow installation from your browser or file manager if prompted. It updates the existing development app.
3. First use: open **More → Scan music**, choose **Folders to scan**, then **Scan now**.
